title: Kuch to bata mujhko zuljanah
body:
Dooba lahu me laut ke, aaya jo Zuljanah
Samjhi Sakina Baba ko, laaya he Zuljanah
Dekhi jo zeen khaali toh, karne lagi ye bayn
Zuljanah, Zuljanah
<<DIVIDER>>
Zuljanah, Zuljanah, Kuch Toh Bata Mujhko Zuljanah
Jo gaya he ghar se aa nahi saka… Haye Zuljana, Haye Zuljanah
Shaam hogaye he, din guzar gaya… Haye Zuljana, Haye Zuljanah Kyun teri bage kateen zulm kya huwa
Khoon se tar he jabeen zulm kya huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyun he zeen khali, Baba he kahaan… Haye Zuljana (2x)
Pusht kyun he zakhmi, khoon he rawaan… Haye Zuljana (2x)
Mere Baba ke wafadar kuch bata
De mujhe sabr aur karaar kuch bata
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer he badan par tere jaa ba jaa… Haye Zuljana (2x) Kyun nahi bata-ta, Kya sitam huwa… Haye Zuljana (2x)
Teri khamoshi me he gham ki kya khabar
Kya me samjhun ke juda hogaye padar
Haath jorh kar me keh rahi thi naa… Haye Zuljana (2x)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ji sakungi kayse Baap ke bina… Haye Zuljana (2x)
Ab jo dunya me mere Baba na rahe
Kon seene pe sulaye ga ab mujhe
Uth gaya jo sar se saaya-e-padar… Haye Zuljana (2x)
<<DIVIDER>>
Soye gi Sakina kayse khaak par… Haye Zuljana (2x)
Shimr le jayega ab baaliya meri
Haye Saadat ki chadar bhi chiney-gi
Qatl ho gaya kya Fatima ka laal… Haye Zuljana (2x)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye dukhi Sakina ho ke pur malaal… Haye Zuljana (2x)
Tujh se ro-ro ke kar rahi thi ilteja
Mere Baba ko suu-e-dasht na leja
Har taraf he laashey, har taraf lahoo… Haye Zuljana (2x)
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhundu me padar ko, kayse chaar-su… Haye Zuljana (2x)
Ayse be-dard la'eeno ke darmiyaan
Tu bata laashe padar paaungi kahaan
Bayn be-khata ke sun ke ro diya… Haye Zuljana (2x)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar jhuka ke apna ran ko chal diya… Haye Zuljana (2x)
Kya kahein Mesum aur Mazhar Abidi
Keh ke ye khaak par Sakina gir gayi
